title: Wave decay and horizon instability on strongly charged extremal Kerr-Newman black holes
summary: We prove the first boundedness and pointwise decay result for the scalar wave equation on rotating extremal black holes without any symmetry assumptions. The result applies to slowly rotating (equivalently, strongly charged) extremal Kerr-Newman spacetimes. We establish uniform energy boundedness, integrated local energy decay, and a hierarchy of boundary-weighted estimates at the extremal horizon and at null infinity, from which inverse-polynomial pointwise decay follows in the entire exterior region.
